AI.comments: 该研究通过引入监督对比学习优化了代码特征的表示，显著提升了LLM生成代码的检测精度。其创新点在于将GraphCodeBERT与两阶段对比学习结合，并考虑了预处理（去除注释）的影响，为代码溯源领域提供了强有力的工具。

title: Chain-of-Thought Degrades Visual Spatial Reasoning Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal Reasoning Models (MRMs) leveraging Chain-of-Thought (CoT) based thinking have revolutionized mathematical and logical problem-solving. However, we show that this paradigm struggles with generalized spatial intelligence. We perform a comprehensive evaluation of seventeen models across thirteen spatial benchmarks and identify a critical gap: CoT prompting consistently degrades performance in visual spatial reasoning. Furthermore, through a novel No-Image++ ablation, we demonstrate that MRMs and CoT prompted MLMs suffer from severe shortcut learning, and hallucinate visual details from textual priors even when the image is absent. These findings challenge the efficacy of text-only CoT for spatial tasks and underscore the need for vision-centric reasoning paradigms.

AI.title_translation: 思维链降低了多模态大模型的视觉空间推理能力
AI.tldr: 思维链（CoT）在多模态大模型处理空间任务时会降低性能，并导致模型因依赖文本先验而产生视觉幻觉。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究思维链（CoT）范式在多模态大模型处理空间智能任务时的有效性，解决当前模型在空间推理中可能存在的性能退化问题。
AI.method: 在13个空间基准测试中评估了17个多模态推理模型，并引入了“No-Image++”消融实验方法，通过对比有无图像输入时的模型表现来分析其对视觉信息的依赖程度。
AI.result: 思维链（CoT）提示在空间推理任务中会导致模型性能稳定下降；同时，模型表现出严重的捷径学习倾向，即使在缺失图像的情况下，也能通过文本先验“幻觉”出视觉细节。
AI.conclusion: 文本驱动的思维链（CoT）在空间推理任务中不仅无效，反而会因模型过度依赖文本先验导致幻觉和性能下降，因此需要转向更具视觉感知能力的推理范式。
AI.translation: 利用基于思维链（CoT）的推理的多模态推理模型（MRMs）彻底改变了数学和逻辑问题的解决方式。然而，我们展示了这种范式在广义空间智能方面存在困难。我们对13个空间基准测试中的17个模型进行了全面评估，并发现了一个关键差距：CoT提示在视觉空间推理中持续降低了性能。此外，通过一种新颖的No-Image++消融实验，我们证明了MRMs和受CoT提示的MLMs遭受严重的捷径学习，即使在没有图像的情况下，也会从文本先验中幻觉出视觉细节。这些发现挑战了纯文本CoT在空间任务中的有效性，并强调了对以视觉为中心的推理范式的需求。
AI.summary: 本文研究了思维链（CoT）在多模态模型空间推理中的表现，通过大规模评估和消融实验发现，CoT反而会削弱模型的空间推理能力，并揭示了模型倾向于利用文本捷径而非真实视觉信息进行决策，从而产生视觉幻觉。
AI.keywords: 多模态大模型, 思维链（CoT）, 空间推理, 幻觉, 捷径学习
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了多模态大模型在空间推理任务中过度依赖文本先验而非视觉信息的现象，对目前流行的CoT范式提出了重要的批判性反思，对于推动真正的视觉中心推理模型发展具有重要意义。

title: Constant-Factor Approximations for Doubly Constrained Fair k-Center, k-Median and k-Means
summary:
We study discrete k-clustering problems in general metric spaces that are constrained by a combination of two different fairness conditions within the demographic fairness model. Given a metric space (P,d), where every point in P is equipped with a protected attribute, and a number k, the goal is to partition P into k clusters with a designated center each, such that a center-based objective function is minimized and the attributes are fairly distributed with respect to the following two fairness concepts: 1) group fairness: We aim for clusters with balanced numbers of attributes by specifying lower and upper bounds for the desired attribute proportions. 2) diverse center selection: Clusters have natural representatives, i.e., their centers. We ask for a balanced set of representatives by specifying the desired number of centers to choose from each attribute.
  Dickerson, Esmaeili, Morgenstern and Zhang (2023) denote the combination of these two constraints as doubly constrained fair clustering. They present algorithms whose guarantees depend on the best known approximation factors for either of these problems. Currently, this implies an 8-approximation with a small additive violation on the group fairness constraint. For k-center, we improve this approximation factor to 4 with a small additive violation. This guarantee also depends on the currently best algorithm for DS-fair k-center given by Jones, Nguyen and Nguyen (2020). For k-median and k-means, we propose the first constant-factor approximation algorithms. Our algorithms transform a solution that satisfies diverse center selection into a doubly constrained fair clustering using an LP-based approach. Furthermore, our results are generalizable to other center-selection constraints, such as matroid k-clustering and knapsack constraints.

AI.title_translation: 双重约束公平k-中心、k-中位数和k-均值问题的常数因子近似算法
AI.tldr: 本文改进了公平聚类算法，首次为双重约束下的k-median和k-means问题提供了常数因子近似，并优化了k-center问题的近似比。
AI.motivation: 针对现有的双重约束公平聚类算法在k-median和k-means问题上缺乏常数因子近似，且k-center的近似比仍有提升空间，作者旨在开发更高效的算法。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于线性规划（LP）的算法框架，通过将满足多样化中心选择的解转换为同时满足群体公平和中心多样性约束的双重公平解。
AI.result: 将k-center的近似比提升至4（伴随少量加性违例），并首次为k-median和k-means提供了常数因子近似算法。同时证明了该方法可推广至拟阵和背包约束。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功为双重约束公平聚类问题（k-center, k-median, k-means）提供了常数因子近似算法，弥补了该领域在此类约束下的理论空白。
AI.translation: 我们研究了在人口统计公平模型下受两种不同公平条件组合约束的一般度量空间中的离散k-聚类问题。给定一个度量空间(P,d)，其中P中的每个点都配备了一个受保护属性，以及一个数字k，目标是将P划分为k个聚类，每个聚类指定一个中心，使得基于中心的客观函数最小化，并且属性在以下两个公平概念方面得到公平分配：1) 群体公平：我们通过指定期望属性比例的下限和上限，旨在实现具有平衡属性数量的聚类。2) 多样化中心选择：聚类具有自然的代表，即它们的中心。我们通过指定从每个属性中选择的期望中心数量来要求一组平衡的代表。Dickerson、Esmaeili、Morgenstern和Zhang（2023）将这两个约束的组合称为双重约束公平聚类。他们提出的算法的保证取决于这些问题中已知的最佳近似因子。目前，这意味着在群体公平约束上具有较小加性违例的8-近似。对于k-center，我们将此近似因子改进为4，并伴有较小的加性违例。此保证也取决于Jones、Nguyen和Nguyen（2020）给出的DS-fair k-center的最佳算法。对于k-median和k-means，我们提出了第一个常数因子近似算法。我们的算法使用基于LP的方法将满足多样化中心选择的解转换为双重约束公平聚类。此外，我们的结果可以推广到其他中心选择约束，例如拟阵k-聚类和背包约束。
AI.summary: 本文研究了度量空间下满足双重公平约束（群体公平与中心多样性）的离散k-聚类问题。作者改进了k-center的算法近似比至4，并首次为k-median和k-means问题设计了常数因子近似算法，证明了该方法在处理复杂中心选择约束时的有效性与通用性。
AI.keywords: 双重约束公平聚类, k-center, k-median, k-means, 近似算法
AI.comments: 该论文在双重约束公平聚类领域取得了重要突破，首次为k-median和k-means问题提供了常数因子近似算法，并改进了k-center的近似比。其基于LP的方法具有良好的通用性，能够扩展到拟阵和背包约束等其他中心选择问题，具有较高的理论价值。

title: VLSF Decoding with Reliability Guarantees over Correlated Noncoherent Fading Channels
comments: Accepted in IEEE International Symposium on Information Theory (ISIT) 2026 Guangzhou, China
summary: This paper studies reliability-guaranteed decoding for variable-length stop-feedback (VLSF) codes over correlated noncoherent fading channels. The decoding rule is based on the evolution of the information density associated with a given channel input-output realization. Due to channel memory, exact evaluation of this information density is intractable. To enable constructive decoding, computable finite-blocklength lower and upper bounds on the information density that hold uniformly over time along each input-output sequence are derived. The lower bound enables a stopping-time analysis for VLSF decoding and has an operational meaning, while the upper bound provides a reference for the relaxation gap, which is explicitly characterized. As a concrete application, the Gauss-Markov fading channel with Gaussian signaling is considered to numerically investigate the stopping-time distribution and the impact of fading correlation on decoding performance.
comment: Accepted in IEEE International Symposium on Information Theory (ISIT) 2026 Guangzhou, China

AI.title_translation: 相关非相干衰落信道下具有可靠性保证的VLSF解码
AI.tldr: 提出了一种在相关非相干衰落信道中实现可靠VLSF解码的方法，通过推导信息密度的可计算上下界，解决了信道记忆带来的评估难题。
AI.motivation: 在存在相关性的非相干衰落信道中，由于信道记忆，精确评估信息密度以实现可靠的变长停止反馈（VLSF）解码变得难以计算。
AI.method: 基于信息密度的演化，推导了在输入-输出序列上一致成立的可计算有限块长下界和上界，并利用下界进行停止时间分析。
AI.result: 导出的下界为VLSF解码提供了操作意义，上界明确了松弛间隙；数值实验表明，该方法可有效分析高斯-马尔可夫衰落信道下的停止时间分布及相关性对性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过导出的信息密度上下界，证明了在具有相关性的非相干衰落信道中，VLSF解码在保证可靠性的前提下是可行的，并量化了松弛间隙。
AI.translation: 本文研究了相关非相干衰落信道下变长停止反馈（VLSF）码的可靠解码。解码规则基于给定信道输入-输出实现的信息密度演化。由于信道记忆，精确评估该信息密度难以实现。为了实现构造性解码，推导了在每个输入-输出序列上随时间一致成立的可计算有限块长下界和上界。下界使得VLSF解码的停止时间分析成为可能并具有操作意义，而上界为松弛间隙提供了参考，该间隙被明确表征。作为一个具体的应用，考虑了具有高斯信令的高斯-马尔可夫衰落信道，以数值方式研究了停止时间分布以及衰落相关性对解码性能的影响。
AI.summary: 本文研究了相关非相干衰落信道中变长停止反馈（VLSF）码的可靠解码问题。针对因信道记忆导致的信息密度难以评估的挑战，提出了一种基于可计算有限块长上下界的解码方法，并应用于高斯-马尔可夫衰落信道，分析了其性能表现。
AI.keywords: 变长停止反馈码, 非相干衰落信道, 信息密度, 信道记忆, 可靠解码
AI.comments: 该论文针对非相干衰落信道下的VLSF编码提供了一种创新的解码方案，通过引入可计算的上下界来处理信道记忆带来的复杂性，具有很强的理论价值和实际应用潜力。其局限性在于主要通过高斯-马尔可夫模型进行数值验证，对于更复杂的信道模型适用性有待进一步研究。

title: AEGIS: Anchor-Enforced Gradient Isolation for Knowledge-Preserving Vision-Language-Action Fine-Tuning
summary: Adapting pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) for robotic control requires injecting high-magnitude continuous gradients from a flow-matching action expert into a backbone trained exclusively with cross-entropy. This cross-modal gradient asymmetry - the spectral dimensionality mismatch between low-rank MSE regression gradients and the high-dimensional semantic manifold sculpted by CE pre-training, causes rapid, severe erosion of the VLM's visual-question-answering (VQA) capability. Industry-standard defences either sever the gradient pathway entirely via stop gradient, discarding the rich continuous supervision, or restrict parameter capacity through low-rank adapters (LoRA) that constrain the rank of updates but not their direction, and thus still overwrite the pre-trained manifold. We introduce AEGIS (Anchor-Enforced Gradient Isolation System): a buffer-free, layer-wise orthogonal gradient projection framework that enables direct continuous MSE learning while preserving the pre-trained VQA manifold - without any co-training data or replay buffer. AEGIS pre-computes a static Gaussian reference anchor from masked VQA forward passes across all transformer layers, then at each training step constructs a Wasserstein-2 transport penalty that generates an anchor restoration gradient. A sequential dual-backward decomposes the task and anchor gradients; for each transformer layer, AEGIS applies a single Gram-Schmidt orthogonal projection that bends the task gradient away from the destructive direction while preserving its constructive content. The projection sheds less than 1% of gradient energy on average, yet eliminates the cumulative activation drift that drives severe forgetting.

AI.title_translation: AEGIS：用于知识保留型视觉-语言-动作微调的锚点强制梯度隔离系统
AI.tldr: AEGIS通过正交投影技术，在微调视觉-语言模型进行机器人控制时，有效防止了原有视觉问答能力的遗忘，且无需额外训练数据。
AI.motivation: 将预训练的VLM应用于机器人控制时，连续动作预测的MSE梯度与预训练的交叉熵梯度之间存在严重的不对称性，导致模型在学习新任务时迅速丢失原有的视觉问答（VQA）能力。
AI.method: 提出AEGIS框架：利用预计算的静态高斯参考锚点，结合Wasserstein-2传输惩罚，并通过Gram-Schmidt正交投影在训练过程中实时调整任务梯度，使其避开破坏预训练语义流形的维度。
AI.result: AEGIS在不使用重放缓冲区或联合训练数据的情况下，有效地保留了VLM的VQA能力，同时实现了高质量的机器人动作控制，仅损失了不到1%的梯度能量。
AI.conclusion: AEGIS通过正交梯度投影技术，成功在保持预训练VLM视觉问答能力的同时，有效地学习了机器人控制任务，显著优于传统的冻结参数或低秩适配方法。
AI.translation: 将预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）适配于机器人控制，需要将来自流匹配动作专家的高幅值连续梯度注入到仅经过交叉熵训练的骨干网络中。这种跨模态梯度不对称性——即低秩MSE回归梯度与交叉熵预训练所塑造的高维语义流形之间的谱维度不匹配，导致了VLM视觉问答（VQA）能力的迅速、严重侵蚀。行业标准的防御措施要么通过停止梯度完全切断梯度通路，从而丢弃了丰富的连续监督信号；要么通过低秩适配器（LoRA）限制参数容量，这仅约束了更新的秩而非方向，因此仍然会覆盖预训练的流形。我们引入了AEGIS（锚点强制梯度隔离系统）：这是一种无缓冲区、逐层的正交梯度投影框架，能够在不使用任何联合训练数据或重放缓冲区的情况下，实现直接的连续MSE学习，同时保留预训练的VQA流形。AEGIS通过跨所有Transformer层的掩码VQA前向传递预计算一个静态高斯参考锚点，然后在每个训练步骤构建一个Wasserstein-2传输惩罚，生成锚点恢复梯度。通过顺序双重反向传播分解任务梯度和锚点梯度；对于每个Transformer层，AEGIS应用一次Gram-Schmidt正交投影，将任务梯度从破坏性方向上偏转，同时保留其建设性内容。该投影平均损失不到1%的梯度能量，但消除了导致严重遗忘的累积激活漂移。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为AEGIS的框架，旨在解决VLM在进行机器人控制微调时发生的灾难性遗忘问题。通过引入锚点强制梯度隔离机制，该方法在训练过程中利用正交投影技术将动作学习梯度从破坏性的方向上偏转，从而在维持高质量动作学习的同时，完美保护了预训练模型的视觉问答能力。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言模型, 机器人控制, 梯度隔离, 正交投影, 灾难性遗忘
AI.comments: 该论文针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）在机器人控制微调中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出了一种非常巧妙的梯度投影机制。其创新之处在于通过Gram-Schmidt正交化技术在训练过程中动态隔离破坏性梯度，无需重放缓冲区或额外数据，为多模态模型的高效适应提供了新思路。

title: TableSeq: Unified Generation of Structure, Content, and Layout
summary: We present TableSeq, an image-only, end-to-end framework for joint table structure recognition, content recognition, and cell localization. The model formulates these tasks as a single sequence-generation problem: one decoder produces an interleaved stream of \texttt{HTML} tags, cell text, and discretized coordinate tokens, thereby aligning logical structure, textual content, and cell geometry within a unified autoregressive sequence. This design avoids external OCR, auxiliary decoders, and complex multi-stage post-processing. TableSeq combines a lightweight high-resolution FCN-H16 encoder with a minimal structure-prior head and a single-layer transformer encoder, yielding a compact architecture that remains effective on challenging layouts. Across standard benchmarks, TableSeq achieves competitive or state-of-the-art results while preserving architectural simplicity. It reaches 95.23 TEDS / 96.83 S-TEDS on PubTabNet, 97.45 TEDS / 98.69 S-TEDS on FinTabNet, and 99.79 / 99.54 / 99.66 precision / recall / F1 on SciTSR under the CAR protocol, while remaining competitive on PubTables-1M under GriTS. Beyond TSR/TCR, the same sequence interface generalizes to index-based table querying without task-specific heads, achieving the best IRDR score and competitive ICDR/ICR performance. We also study multi-token prediction for faster blockwise decoding and show that it reduces inference latency with only limited accuracy degradation. Overall, TableSeq provides a practical and reproducible single-stream baseline for unified table recognition, and the source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/hamdilaziz/TableSeq.

AI.title_translation: TableSeq：结构、内容与布局的统一生成
AI.tldr: TableSeq将表格识别简化为单一的序列生成任务，通过单一解码器统一处理结构、内容和位置，无需外部OCR即可实现高性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的表格识别方法通常依赖复杂的外部OCR、多个辅助解码器或多阶段后处理，导致架构臃肿且难以维护，作者旨在构建一个统一、简洁的端到端框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种仅基于图像的端到端框架TableSeq，利用一个解码器生成包含HTML标签、单元格文本和离散化坐标的交织序列，结合了轻量级高分辨率FCN-H16编码器和单层Transformer解码器。
AI.result: 在PubTabNet、FinTabNet和SciTSR等多个基准测试上取得了具有竞争力的或最先进的性能，并证明了其在表格查询任务中的泛化能力及通过多标记预测加速推理的潜力。
AI.conclusion: TableSeq证明了通过单一的自回归序列生成框架，可以高效地同时解决表格结构识别、内容识别和单元格定位任务，且具有良好的通用性和推理效率。
AI.translation: 我们提出了TableSeq，一个仅基于图像的端到端框架，用于联合进行表格结构识别、内容识别和单元格定位。该模型将这些任务表述为一个单一的序列生成问题：一个解码器生成HTML标签、单元格文本和离散坐标标记的交织流，从而在统一的自回归序列中对齐逻辑结构、文本内容和单元格几何形状。这种设计避免了外部OCR、辅助解码器和复杂的多阶段后处理。TableSeq结合了轻量级高分辨率FCN-H16编码器、最小结构先验头和单层Transformer解码器，产生了一个在复杂布局下依然有效的紧凑架构。在标准基准测试中，TableSeq在保持架构简洁的同时，取得了具有竞争力或最先进的结果。它在PubTabNet上达到95.23 TEDS / 96.83 S-TEDS，在FinTabNet上达到97.45 TEDS / 98.69 S-TEDS，在SciTSR的CAR协议下达到99.79 / 99.54 / 99.66的精度/召回率/F1，并在PubTables-1M的GriTS指标上保持竞争力。除了TSR/TCR，该序列接口无需特定任务头即可推广到基于索引的表格查询，实现了最佳的IRDR得分和具有竞争力的ICDR/ICR性能。我们还研究了用于更快块级解码的多标记预测，并表明它在仅有有限精度下降的情况下降低了推理延迟。总的来说，TableSeq为统一表格识别提供了一个实用且可复现的单流基准，源代码将在https://github.com/hamdilaziz/TableSeq公开。
AI.summary: TableSeq是一个统一的端到端表格识别框架，通过将结构、内容和定位任务转化为单一的自回归序列生成问题，消除了对复杂后处理和外部OCR的依赖，在保持架构简洁的同时实现了卓越的识别性能。
AI.keywords: 表格识别, 序列生成, 端到端框架, 单元格定位
AI.comments: TableSeq的创新之处在于将原本复杂的表格理解任务（结构、内容、定位）统一为一个单一的序列生成问题，极大地简化了模型架构并摒弃了对外部OCR的依赖，这在实际应用部署中非常有价值。

title: Finding Patient Zero via Low-Dimensional Geometric Embeddings
summary: We study the patient zero problem in epidemic spreading processes in the independent cascade model and propose a geometric approach for source reconstruction. Using Johnson-Lindenstrauss projections, we embed the contact network into a low-dimensional Euclidean space and estimate the infection source as the node closest to the center of gravity of infected nodes. Simulations on Erdős-Rényi graphs demonstrate that our estimator achieves meaningful reconstruction accuracy despite operating on compressed observations.

AI.title_translation: 通过低维几何嵌入寻找“零号病人”
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用降维几何嵌入和质心定位技术来高效识别流行病感染源的新方法，并在压缩观测条件下验证了其准确性。
AI.motivation: 在独立级联模型下，寻找流行病的起源（Patient Zero）是一个具有挑战性的问题，现有方法在处理大规模网络时计算开销较大。作者旨在开发一种基于几何嵌入的轻量级方法来高效地重建感染源。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于几何的溯源方法，首先利用Johnson-Lindenstrauss投影将接触网络嵌入到低维欧几里得空间，然后将感染节点集合的质心作为感染源的估计位置。
AI.result: 在Erdős-Rényi图上的模拟实验表明，该方法即便在压缩观测数据的情况下，仍能实现有意义的感染源重建准确率。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了利用低维几何嵌入和质心估计方法，即便在压缩观测条件下，也能有效地识别流行病的感染源，为流行病溯源提供了一种高效的计算框架。
AI.translation: 我们研究了独立级联模型中流行病传播过程的“零号病人”问题，并提出了一种用于源重建的几何方法。利用Johnson-Lindenstrauss投影，我们将接触网络嵌入到一个低维欧几里得空间中，并将感染源估计为最接近感染节点质心的节点。在Erdős-Rényi图上的模拟表明，尽管该估计器是在压缩观测下运行的，但仍能实现有意义的重建精度。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了独立级联模型下的流行病溯源问题，并提出了一种基于几何嵌入的创新方法。通过应用Johnson-Lindenstrauss投影将接触网络降维，作者利用感染节点的质心位置来估计感染源，并通过仿真验证了该方法在压缩观测下仍具有良好的重建性能。
AI.keywords: 流行病溯源, 低维嵌入, 独立级联模型, Johnson-Lindenstrauss投影, 网络拓扑
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种利用几何嵌入方法解决流行病溯源问题的新思路，通过降维技术处理复杂网络数据，显著降低了计算复杂度。其创新点在于将网络拓扑结构映射到低维欧几里得空间，利用质心定位感染源，这为大规模网络下的溯源分析提供了高效的近似方案。其局限性在于主要基于Erdős-Rényi随机图模型进行验证，在真实世界的复杂网络结构中的表现仍需进一步研究。

title: Towards Universal Convergence of Backward Error in Linear System Solvers
summary: The quest for an algorithm that solves an $n\times n$ linear system in $O(n^2)$ time complexity, or $O(n^2 \text{poly}(1/ε))$ when solving up to $ε$ relative error, is a long-standing open problem in numerical linear algebra and theoretical computer science. There are two predominant paradigms for measuring relative error: forward error (i.e., distance from the output to the optimum solution) and backward error (i.e., distance to the nearest problem solved by the output). In most prior studies, convergence of iterative linear system solvers is measured via various notions of forward error, and as a result, depends heavily on the conditioning of the input. Yet, the numerical analysis literature has long advocated for backward error as the more practically relevant notion of approximation. In this work, we show that -- surprisingly -- the classical and simple Richardson iteration incurs at most $1/k$ (relative) backward error after $k$ iterations on any positive semidefinite (PSD) linear system, irrespective of its condition number. This universal convergence rate implies an $O(n^2/ε)$ complexity algorithm for solving a PSD linear system to $ε$ backward error, and we establish similar or better complexity when using a variety of Krylov solvers beyond Richardson. Then, by directly minimizing backward error over a Krylov subspace, we attain an even faster $O(1/k^2)$ universal rate, and we turn this into an efficient algorithm, MINBERR, with complexity $O(n^2/\sqrtε)$. We extend this approach via normal equations to solving general linear systems, for which we empirically observe $O(1/k)$ convergence. We report strong numerical performance of our algorithms on benchmark problems.

AI.title_translation: 迈向线性系统求解器中后向误差的通用收敛性
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了线性系统求解器中后向误差的通用收敛规律，证明了Richardson迭代在PSD系统下具有与条件数无关的收敛性，并提出了高效的MINBERR算法。
AI.motivation: 传统线性系统求解器的收敛性通常基于前向误差，严重依赖于矩阵的条件数。研究旨在探索更具实际意义的后向误差收敛性，并寻求实现$O(n^2)$级别的计算复杂度。
AI.method: 分析了Richardson迭代在PSD系统中的后向误差收敛性，利用Krylov子空间最小化后向误差提出MINBERR算法，并将方法通过正规方程扩展至一般线性系统。
AI.result: 证明了Richardson迭代在PSD系统下具有与条件数无关的$1/k$通用后向误差收敛率；提出了MINBERR算法，实现了$O(n^2/\sqrtε)$的复杂度；在一般线性系统上观察到$O(1/k)$的收敛速度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了后向误差在迭代线性系统求解器中的通用收敛性，并提出了一种高效的MINBERR算法，为解决一般线性系统提供了更优的复杂度保证。
AI.translation: 寻找一种能在$O(n^2)$时间复杂度内，或在求解至$ε$相对误差时达到$O(n^2 \text{poly}(1/ε))$复杂度的$n \times n$线性系统求解算法，是数值线性代数和理论计算机科学中一个长期存在的开放性问题。衡量相对误差主要有两种范式：前向误差（即输出与最优解的距离）和后向误差（即到输出所解决的最近问题的距离）。在大多数先前的研究中，迭代线性系统求解器的收敛性是通过各种前向误差概念来衡量的，因此很大程度上依赖于输入的条件数。然而，数值分析文献长期以来一直主张将后向误差作为更具实际意义的近似概念。在这项工作中，我们令人惊讶地证明了，经典的Richardson迭代在任何正定（PSD）线性系统上经过$k$次迭代后，其（相对）后向误差最多为$1/k$，且与条件数无关。这种通用收敛率意味着存在一种将PSD线性系统求解至$ε$后向误差的$O(n^2/ε)$复杂度算法，并且我们在使用除Richardson之外的多种Krylov求解器时，也建立了类似或更好的复杂度。随后，通过直接在Krylov子空间上最小化后向误差，我们获得了更快的$O(1/k^2)$通用收敛率，并将其转化为一种高效的算法MINBERR，其复杂度为$O(n^2/\sqrtε)$。我们通过正规方程将此方法扩展到求解一般线性系统，并凭经验观察到$O(1/k)$的收敛性。我们在基准问题上报告了我们算法的强大数值性能。
AI.summary: 本文研究了线性系统求解器中后向误差的通用收敛性。作者证明了Richardson迭代在处理正定（PSD）系统时，其后向误差收敛速度与条件数无关，并据此提出了MINBERR算法，实现了更快的收敛复杂度。该方法通过正规方程进一步推广至一般线性系统，并在数值实验中表现出优异性能。
AI.keywords: 线性系统求解器, 后向误差, Richardson迭代, Krylov子空间, MINBERR算法
AI.comments: 该论文通过将焦点从前向误差转向后向误差，在数值线性代数领域取得了重要的理论突破。其核心创新在于证明了即使对于病态矩阵，简单的Richardson迭代也能实现与条件数无关的通用收敛速度，并提出了MINBERR算法，为解决线性系统提供了一种更具鲁棒性的新范式。

title: Prototype-Grounded Concept Models for Verifiable Concept Alignment
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) aim to improve interpretability in Deep Learning by structuring predictions through human-understandable concepts, but they provide no way to verify whether learned concepts align with the human's intended meaning, hurting interpretability. We introduce Prototype-Grounded Concept Models (PGCMs), which ground concepts in learned visual prototypes: image parts that serve as explicit evidence for the concepts. This grounding enables direct inspection of concept semantics and supports targeted human intervention at the prototype level to correct misalignments. Empirically, PGCMs match the predictive performance of state-of-the-art CBMs while substantially improving transparency, interpretability, and intervenability.

AI.title_translation: 用于可验证概念对齐的原型基础概念模型
AI.tldr: 通过将概念与可视化原型绑定，该模型让深度学习的决策过程更透明，并允许人类直接纠正模型对概念的错误理解。
AI.motivation: 现有的概念瓶颈模型（CBMs）虽然利用人类可理解的概念进行预测，但缺乏验证机制来确保模型学习到的概念与人类意图对齐，从而限制了其可解释性。
AI.method: 提出原型基础概念模型（PGCMs），通过将概念与学习到的视觉原型（即图像中作为概念明确证据的部分）进行关联，实现对概念语义的直接检查及针对性的原型级人工干预。
AI.result: 实验表明，PGCMs 在保持与现有最先进 CBMs 相当的预测性能的同时，在透明度、可解释性和可干预性方面均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: PGCMs 通过原型基础实现了对概念语义的直接检查与干预，在保持高性能的同时，显著增强了深度学习模型的可解释性与可控性。
AI.translation: 概念瓶颈模型（CBMs）旨在通过人类可理解的概念来构建预测，从而提高深度学习的可解释性。然而，它们无法验证学习到的概念是否与人类预期的含义对齐，这损害了其可解释性。我们引入了原型基础概念模型（PGCMs），将概念建立在学习到的视觉原型之上：即作为概念明确证据的图像部分。这种基础使得能够直接检查概念语义，并支持在原型层面进行有针对性的人工干预以纠正偏差。实证结果表明，PGCMs 在匹配最先进 CBMs 预测性能的同时，显著提高了透明度、可解释性和可干预性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新型的原型基础概念模型（PGCMs），旨在解决概念瓶颈模型中概念对齐难以验证的问题。通过将概念与具体的视觉原型挂钩，该方法不仅允许用户直接检查概念的语义，还支持对模型进行精准的纠偏干预，从而在保证模型性能的前提下提升了可解释性。
AI.keywords: 概念瓶颈模型, 原型基础, 可解释性, 概念对齐, 人机交互
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入原型（Prototypes）作为概念的视觉证据，有效地解决了概念瓶颈模型（CBM）中概念对齐不可验证的问题，不仅提升了模型的可解释性，还赋予了人类干预模型内部决策的能力。这是一个在可信AI和人机协同领域非常有价值的改进。

title: The Amazing Stability of Flow Matching
comments: EurIPS 2025 Workshop on Principles of Generative Modeling (PriGM)
summary:
The success of deep generative models in generating high-quality and diverse samples is often attributed to particular architectures and large training datasets. In this paper, we investigate the impact of these factors on the quality and diversity of samples generated by \emph{flow-matching} models. Surprisingly, in our experiments on CelebA-HQ dataset, flow matching remains stable even when pruning 50\% of the dataset. That is, the quality and diversity of generated samples are preserved. Moreover, pruning impacts the latent representation only slightly, that is, samples generated by models trained on the full and pruned dataset map to visually similar outputs for a given seed. We observe similar stability when changing the architecture or training configuration, such that the latent representation is maintained under these changes as well.
  Our results quantify just how strong this stability can be in practice, and help explain the reliability of flow-matching models under various perturbations.
comment: EurIPS 2025 Workshop on Principles of Generative Modeling (PriGM)

AI.tldr: 流匹配模型表现出极强的稳定性，即使在修剪一半训练数据或更改架构后，仍能保持高质量和多样化的生成效果。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究架构和训练数据集大小对流匹配生成模型质量与多样性的具体影响，以理解该类模型在各种扰动下的可靠性。
AI.method: 通过在CelebA-HQ数据集上进行实验，对比全量数据集与修剪50%数据集后的模型表现，并分析不同架构和训练配置下的模型输出及潜在表示变化。
AI.result: 实验表明，即便修剪掉50%的训练数据，流匹配模型仍能保持样本的质量与多样性；同时，不同训练配置和架构下的潜在表示具有高度一致性。
AI.conclusion: 流匹配模型展现出极强的稳定性，其生成的样本质量和多样性在面对显著的数据修剪和架构变更时依然能够保持。
AI.translation: 深度生成模型在生成高质量和多样化样本方面的成功通常归功于特定的架构和大规模训练数据集。在本文中，我们研究了这些因素对流匹配（flow-matching）模型生成的样本质量和多样性的影响。令人惊讶的是，我们在CelebA-HQ数据集上的实验表明，即使修剪了50%的数据集，流匹配依然保持稳定，即生成的样本质量和多样性得以保留。此外，修剪对潜在表示的影响微乎其微，即对于给定的随机种子，在全量数据集和修剪后的数据集上训练的模型所生成的样本映射到视觉上相似的输出。我们在改变架构或训练配置时也观察到了类似的稳定性，潜在表示在这些变化下也得到了维持。我们的结果量化了这种稳定性在实践中究竟有多强，并有助于解释流匹配模型在各种扰动下的可靠性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了流匹配模型在数据修剪及架构调整下的稳定性。实验发现，流匹配在面对50%的数据修剪时仍能保持良好的生成性能，且其潜在表示在不同训练条件或架构下表现出高度的一致性，证明了该模型在各种扰动下的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 流匹配, 生成模型, 鲁棒性, 数据修剪, 潜在表示
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了流匹配（Flow Matching）模型在面对数据修剪、架构调整和训练配置改变时表现出的惊人鲁棒性。这种稳定性对于理解生成模型的可靠性具有重要意义，表明流匹配在处理训练数据变化时比预期更具弹性。

title: ProcRoute: Process-Scoped Authorization of Split-Tunnel Routes
summary: In most split-tunnel VPN/ZTNA deployments, installing an internal route authorizes the entire device, not a specific application, to use it. An unprivileged malicious process can therefore reach internal services by reusing routes intended for corporate applications. We present ProcRoute, a system that restricts internal-route access to explicitly authorized applications. ProcRoute models route access as an access-control problem: application identities are principals, destination prefixes with port and protocol constraints are resources, and a total, default-deny decision function mediates every connect() and UDP sendmsg() to an internal destination. Processes without a grant retain external access but are denied internal routes under our threat model. We describe ProcRoute's formal model, a Linux prototype built on cgroup v2 and eBPF socket-address hooks, and two complementary evaluations. In a two-machine WireGuard deployment, ProcRoute matches the WireGuard baseline and 13% faster than an nftables cgroup-matching configuration, with a p50 connect latency of 93 $μ$s (+3.6 $μ$s over baseline), flat policy scaling to 5,000 prefixes, and sub-millisecond revocation. Single-machine loopback microbenchmarks confirm low hook overhead: 2.7 $μ$s on the internal-allow path, 82/82 unauthorized pivot attempts blocked, and zero transient allows across 1.2 million connection attempts during policy reload.

AI.title_translation: ProcRoute：分流路由的进程级授权
AI.tldr: ProcRoute 通过 eBPF 技术将分流 VPN 的路由权限细化到单个应用程序，有效防止恶意进程滥用内部路由，同时保持了极高的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有分流 VPN/ZTNA 部署通常在设备层面授权路由，导致恶意进程可以利用为授权应用设计的内部路由访问敏感服务，缺乏细粒度的进程级访问控制。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于访问控制模型的系统，将应用身份作为主体，目的地前缀、端口和协议作为资源；利用 Linux 的 cgroup v2 和 eBPF socket-address 钩子机制，对 connect() 和 UDP sendmsg() 系统调用进行强制的默认拒绝（default-deny）访问控制。
AI.result: 在 WireGuard 部署中，ProcRoute 性能优于 nftables 配置，连接延迟仅增加 3.6 μs，支持 5,000 个前缀的策略扩展，且在 120 万次连接尝试中未发现瞬时授权泄露，阻断了所有未授权的跳转尝试。
AI.conclusion: ProcRoute 成功证明了在不显著增加延迟的情况下，通过细粒度的进程级授权来加固分流 VPN/ZTNA 部署的可行性，有效防御了未授权进程滥用内部路由。
AI.translation: 在大多数分流 VPN/ZTNA 部署中，安装内部路由会授权整个设备使用它，而不是特定的应用程序。因此，一个无特权的恶意进程可以通过重用本应给企业应用程序使用的路由来访问内部服务。我们提出了 ProcRoute，这是一个将内部路由访问限制为明确授权应用程序的系统。ProcRoute 将路由访问建模为一个访问控制问题：应用程序身份是主体，具有端口和协议约束的目标前缀是资源，并且一个完全的、默认拒绝的决策函数会调解每一个针对内部目标的 connect() 和 UDP sendmsg() 调用。在我们的威胁模型下，没有授权的进程保留外部访问权限，但被拒绝使用内部路由。我们描述了 ProcRoute 的形式化模型、基于 cgroup v2 和 eBPF socket-address 钩子的 Linux 原型，以及两项补充评估。在双机 WireGuard 部署中，ProcRoute 与 WireGuard 基线相当，比 nftables cgroup 匹配配置快 13%，p50 连接延迟为 93 μs（比基线增加 3.6 μs），策略可扩展至 5,000 个前缀，且撤销时间在毫秒级。单机回环微基准测试证实了其较低的钩子开销：内部允许路径上为 2.7 μs，82/82 次未经授权的跳转尝试被拦截，在策略重新加载期间的 120 万次连接尝试中，零瞬时授权发生。
AI.summary: ProcRoute 是一种用于分流 VPN/ZTNA 的进程级路由授权系统。它通过将路由访问建模为访问控制问题，利用 eBPF 技术在系统调用层面强制执行细粒度的访问策略，确保只有经过授权的应用程序才能访问内部网络资源，从而防止恶意进程滥用网络路由。
AI.keywords: 分流 VPN, 零信任网络访问, eBPF, 进程级授权, 网络安全
AI.comments: ProcRoute 通过将路由权限从设备级细化到应用级，有效解决了传统分流 VPN 中存在的内部网络横向移动威胁。其基于 eBPF 和 cgroup v2 的实现展示了极高的性能和安全性，是零信任架构在操作系统网络层实现的一个优秀范例。

title: Veritas-RPM: Provenance-Guided Multi-Agent False Positive Suppression for Remote Patient Monitoring
summary: We present Veritas-RPM, a provenance-guided multi-agent architecture comprising five processing layers: VeritasAgent (ground-truth assembly), SentinelLayer (anomaly detection), DirectorAgent (specialist routing), six domain Specialist Agents, and MetaSentinelAgent (conflict resolution and final decision). We construct a 98-case synthetic taxonomy of false-positive scenarios derived from documented RPM patterns. Synthetic patient epochs (n = 530) were generated directly from taxonomy parameters and processed through the pipeline. Ground-truth labels are known for all cases. Performance is reported as True Suppression Rate (TSR), False Escalation Rate (FER), and Indeterminate Rate (INDR).

AI.title_translation: Veritas-RPM：远程患者监测中基于溯源引导的多智能体假阳性抑制系统
AI.tldr: Veritas-RPM 是一种利用多智能体协作和溯源技术来减少远程医疗中假阳性报警的创新架构。
AI.motivation: 远程患者监测（RPM）系统中频繁出现的假阳性报警导致了警报疲劳，严重影响临床效率和患者护理质量，需要更精确的自动抑制机制。
AI.method: 提出包含五个处理层的 Veritas-RPM 多智能体架构（VeritasAgent、SentinelLayer、DirectorAgent、6个领域专家智能体、MetaSentinelAgent）；构建包含98种假阳性场景的合成分类法，并基于此生成530个合成患者数据进行验证。
AI.result: 通过评估指标（真抑制率 TSR、假升级率 FER、不确定率 INDR）验证了该架构在处理合成假阳性场景中的性能。
AI.conclusion: Veritas-RPM 通过分层多智能体架构有效提升了远程医疗监测中假阳性报警的抑制能力，证明了溯源引导决策在处理医疗复杂报警中的价值。
AI.translation: 我们提出了 Veritas-RPM，这是一种由五个处理层组成的溯源引导多智能体架构：VeritasAgent（地面实况组装）、SentinelLayer（异常检测）、DirectorAgent（专家路由）、六个领域专家智能体以及 MetaSentinelAgent（冲突解决与最终决策）。我们构建了一个包含98种假阳性场景的合成分类法，这些场景源自记录在案的 RPM 模式。直接根据分类参数生成了合成患者时期（n = 530），并通过该流程进行了处理。所有案例的地面实况标签均已知。性能报告指标包括真抑制率 (TSR)、假升级率 (FER) 和不确定率 (INDR)。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 Veritas-RPM，这是一个基于溯源引导的多智能体架构，旨在减少远程患者监测中的假阳性警报。该系统通过分层处理流程，包括基准组装、异常检测、专家路由及冲突解决，并在由98种假阳性场景组成的合成数据集上进行了性能验证。
AI.keywords: 远程医疗监测, 多智能体架构, 假阳性抑制, 数据溯源, 医疗报警系统
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入溯源机制（Provenance-Guided）和多智能体协作，为解决远程医疗监测中的假阳性报警问题提供了一种结构化、可解释的框架。其创新点在于将复杂的临床决策过程分解为分层的多智能体任务，并利用合成数据集对系统进行严格的性能基准测试。局限性在于目前主要基于合成数据，在真实临床环境中的鲁棒性仍需进一步验证。

title: Early Detection of Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) Using YOLOv12 Deep Learning Model
summary: Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) is one of the most life-threatening type of blood cancers, and its accurate classification is considered and remains a challenging task due to the visual similarity between various cell types. This study addresses the classification of the multiclasses of AML cells Utilizing YOLOv12 deep learning model. We applied two segmentation approaches based on cell and nucleus features, using Hue channel and Otsu thresholding techniques to preprocess the images prior to classification. Our experiments demonstrate that YOLOv12 with Otsu thresholding on cell-based segmentation achieved the highest level of validation and test accuracy, both reaching 99.3%.

AI.title_translation: 基于YOLOv12深度学习模型的急性髓系白血病（AML）早期检测
AI.tldr: 本研究通过YOLOv12模型结合Otsu阈值分割技术，实现了急性髓系白血病（AML）细胞99.3%的高精度分类。
AI.motivation: 急性髓系白血病（AML）因各类细胞在视觉上高度相似，导致其准确分类成为一项极具挑战性的医学任务，亟需更有效的自动化检测方法。
AI.method: 首先利用色调（Hue）通道和Otsu阈值技术对图像进行基于细胞和细胞核特征的分割预处理，随后使用YOLOv12深度学习模型进行AML多分类任务。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在基于细胞的分割方法下，结合Otsu阈值处理的YOLOv12模型表现最优，验证集和测试集准确率均达到99.3%。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，结合Otsu阈值分割预处理的YOLOv12模型是实现急性髓系白血病（AML）高精度分类的有效方案。
AI.translation: 急性髓系白血病（AML）是最危及生命的血液癌症之一，由于各类细胞在视觉上的相似性，其准确分类仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。本研究利用YOLOv12深度学习模型解决了AML细胞的多分类问题。我们应用了两种基于细胞和细胞核特征的分割方法，并在分类前利用色调通道和Otsu阈值技术对图像进行预处理。实验证明，采用Otsu阈值处理的基于细胞分割的YOLOv12模型在验证集和测试集上均达到了99.3%的最高准确率。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种利用YOLOv12深度学习模型进行急性髓系白血病（AML）细胞分类的新方法。通过对比不同的分割策略（细胞与细胞核特征）及预处理技术（色调通道与Otsu阈值法），研究发现基于细胞分割且采用Otsu阈值的YOLOv12方案在AML分类中具有卓越的性能。
AI.keywords: 急性髓系白血病, YOLOv12, 图像分割, 深度学习, 疾病分类
AI.comments: 该研究将最新的YOLOv12模型应用于医学图像分类，展示了深度学习在处理血液癌症复杂分类任务中的巨大潜力，特别是通过结合传统的图像预处理技术（如Otsu阈值法）显著提升了模型性能。未来的研究可以进一步探讨该模型在不同数据集上的泛化能力及临床应用的可行性。

title: DINOv3 Beats Specialized Detectors: A Simple Foundation Model Baseline for Image Forensics
summary: With the rapid advancement of deep generative models, realistic fake images have become increasingly accessible, yet existing localization methods rely on complex designs and still struggle to generalize across manipulation types and imaging conditions. We present a simple but strong baseline based on DINOv3 with LoRA adaptation and a lightweight convolutional decoder. Under the CAT-Net protocol, our best model improves average pixel-level F1 by 17.0 points over the previous state of the art on four standard benchmarks using only 9.1\,M trainable parameters on top of a frozen ViT-L backbone, and even our smallest variant surpasses all prior specialized methods. LoRA consistently outperforms full fine-tuning across all backbone scales. Under the data-scarce MVSS-Net protocol, LoRA reaches an average F1 of 0.774 versus 0.530 for the strongest prior method, while full fine-tuning becomes highly unstable, suggesting that pre-trained representations encode forensic information that is better preserved than overwritten. The baseline also exhibits strong robustness to Gaussian noise, JPEG re-compression, and Gaussian blur. We hope this work can serve as a reliable baseline for the research community and a practical starting point for future image-forensic applications. Code is available at https://github.com/Irennnne/DINOv3-IML.

AI.title_translation: DINOv3击败专用检测器：一个用于图像取证的简单基础模型基准
AI.tldr: 通过利用DINOv3和LoRA适配，研究者构建了一个在图像伪造定位任务中表现优异且高效的基准模型，大幅超越了此前的专用方法。
AI.motivation: 现有图像取证方法设计复杂，且难以在不同操作类型和成像条件下实现良好的泛化。
AI.method: 使用冻结的DINOv3（ViT-L）作为骨干网络，结合LoRA适配器进行参数高效微调，并配备轻量级卷积解码器进行伪造定位。
AI.result: 在CAT-Net协议下，平均像素级F1值比现有SOTA提升了17.0个点；在数据稀缺的MVSS-Net协议下，平均F1达到0.774，远超之前的0.530，并表现出良好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DINOv3结合LoRA是图像取证领域的一个简单、高效且鲁棒的基准模型，优于现有的专用检测器。
AI.translation: 随着深度生成模型的快速发展，逼真的伪造图像变得越来越容易获取，但现有的定位方法依赖于复杂的设计，且在不同操作类型和成像条件下的泛化能力较弱。我们提出了一个基于DINOv3的简单而强大的基准，结合了LoRA适配和轻量级卷积解码器。在CAT-Net协议下，我们的最佳模型在四个标准基准测试中，仅在冻结的ViT-L骨干网络上使用9.1M可训练参数，就将平均像素级F1分数比先前的SOTA提高了17.0个点，甚至我们最小的变体也超过了所有先前的专用方法。LoRA在所有骨干规模上均持续优于全参数微调。在数据稀缺的MVSS-Net协议下，LoRA达到了0.774的平均F1，而最强的前人方法为0.530，同时全参数微调变得非常不稳定，这表明预训练表示中编码的取证信息被保留的效果优于被覆盖的效果。该基准还对高斯噪声、JPEG重压缩和高斯模糊表现出很强的鲁棒性。我们希望这项工作能为研究社区提供一个可靠的基准，并为未来的图像取证应用提供一个实用的起点。代码可在https://github.com/Irennnne/DINOv3-IML获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于DINOv3基础模型的简单图像取证基准。通过引入LoRA适配器和轻量级解码器，该方法在多个标准基准测试中显著超越了现有的专用检测器，特别是在数据受限的情况下表现出卓越的性能和训练稳定性。
AI.keywords: DINOv3, 图像取证, LoRA, 伪造检测, 基础模型
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于利用通用的基础模型（DINOv3）通过轻量级的LoRA适配器在图像取证任务中取得了超越专用检测器的性能，证明了基础模型中预训练特征的强大泛化能力。其局限性在于未提及对最新、更复杂的生成式攻击手段的防御能力，且仅基于现有基准测试。

title: Unveiling Stochasticity: Universal Multi-modal Probabilistic Modeling for Traffic Forecasting
summary: Traffic forecasting is a challenging spatio-temporal modeling task and a critical component of urban transportation management. Current studies mainly focus on deterministic predictions, with limited considerations on the uncertainty and stochasticity in traffic dynamics. Therefore, this paper proposes an elegant yet universal approach that transforms existing models into probabilistic predictors by replacing only the final output layer with a novel Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) layer. The modified model requires no changes to the training pipeline and can be trained using only the Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) loss, without any auxiliary or regularization terms. Experiments on multiple traffic datasets show that our approach generalizes from classic to modern model architectures while preserving deterministic performance. Furthermore, we propose a systematic evaluation procedure based on cumulative distributions and confidence intervals, and demonstrate that our approach is considerably more accurate and informative than unimodal or deterministic baselines. Finally, a more detailed study on a real-world dense urban traffic network is presented to examine the impact of data quality on uncertainty quantification and to show the robustness of our approach under imperfect data conditions. Code available at https://github.com/Weijiang-Xiong/OpenSkyTraffic

AI.title_translation: 揭示随机性：用于交通预测的通用多模态概率建模
AI.tldr: 提出一种将现有交通预测模型转为概率预测器的通用方法，通过引入GMM层有效量化交通不确定性，且无需改变原有训练流程。
AI.motivation: 现有的交通预测研究多集中于确定性预测，忽视了交通动态中固有的不确定性和随机性，导致预测结果缺乏鲁棒性和信息深度。
AI.method: 提出一种通用的概率建模框架，通过将现有交通预测模型的最后一层替换为高斯混合模型（GMM）层，并使用负对数似然（NLL）损失函数进行端到端训练。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法能无缝适配多种模型架构，在保持确定性预测性能的同时，提供了更准确的不确定性量化，并在非理想数据条件下表现出良好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的通用概率建模方法能有效量化交通预测的不确定性，在保证确定性预测精度的同时，提供了更丰富、更准确的决策信息。
AI.translation: 交通预测是一项具有挑战性的时空建模任务，也是城市交通管理的关键组成部分。目前的研究主要集中在确定性预测上，对交通动态中的不确定性和随机性考虑有限。因此，本文提出了一种优雅而通用的方法，通过仅替换最终输出层为一种新型高斯混合模型（GMM）层，将现有模型转化为概率预测器。修改后的模型不需要改变训练流程，并且仅使用负对数似然（NLL）损失函数进行训练，无需任何辅助或正则化项。在多个交通数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法可以从经典模型架构推广到现代模型架构，同时保持确定性性能。此外，我们提出了一种基于累积分布和置信区间的系统评估程序，并证明我们的方法比单模态或确定性基准更准确、信息量更大。最后，对一个真实的密集城市交通网络进行了更详细的研究，以检查数据质量对不确定性量化的影响，并展示了我们的方法在不完美数据条件下的鲁棒性。代码可在 https://github.com/Weijiang-Xiong/OpenSkyTraffic 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通用的概率预测框架，通过在现有模型末端引入高斯混合模型（GMM）层，实现了对交通流不确定性的有效建模。该方法无需修改训练流程，仅通过NLL损失函数即可训练，在交通预测中表现出高精度和强鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 交通预测, 概率建模, 高斯混合模型, 不确定性量化, 时空建模
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种极具普适性的方法，将确定性交通预测模型转化为概率模型，不仅降低了实施门槛，还通过GMM层有效捕捉了交通流的不确定性，对实际交通管理决策具有重要意义。

title: Stylistic-STORM (ST-STORM) : Perceiving the Semantic Nature of Appearance
comments: 20 pages, 16 figures, ICPR 2026 (28th International Conference on Pattern Recognition)
summary: One of the dominant paradigms in self-supervised learning (SSL), illustrated by MoCo or DINO, aims to produce robust representations by capturing features that are insensitive to certain image transformations such as illumination, or geometric changes. This strategy is appropriate when the objective is to recognize objects independently of their appearance. However, it becomes counterproductive as soon as appearance itself constitutes the discriminative signal. In weather analysis, for example, rain streaks, snow granularity, atmospheric scattering, as well as reflections and halos, are not noise: they carry the essential information. In critical applications such as autonomous driving, ignoring these cues is risky, since grip and visibility depend directly on ground conditions and atmospheric conditions. We introduce ST-STORM, a hybrid SSL framework that treats appearance (style) as a semantic modality to be disentangled from content. Our architecture explicitly separates two latent streams, regulated by gating mechanisms. The Content branch aims at a stable semantic representation through a JEPA scheme coupled with a contrastive objective, promoting invariance to appearance variations. In parallel, the Style branch is constrained to capture appearance signatures (textures, contrasts, scattering) through feature prediction and reconstruction under an adversarial constraint. We evaluate ST-STORM on several tasks, including object classification (ImageNet-1K), fine-grained weather characterization, and melanoma detection (ISIC 2024 Challenge). The results show that the Style branch effectively isolates complex appearance phenomena (F1=97% on Multi-Weather and F1=94% on ISIC 2024 with 10% labeled data), without degrading the semantic performance (F1=80% on ImageNet-1K) of the Content branch, and improves the preservation of critical appearance
comment: 20 pages, 16 figures, ICPR 2026 (28th International Conference on Pattern Recognition)

AI.tldr: ST-STORM 是一种新型自监督学习框架，通过显式分离内容和风格分支，在保持语义识别能力的同时，能有效提取和利用关键的外观特征。
AI.motivation: 现有的自监督学习方法（如 MoCo, DINO）追求对外观变化的不变性，这在需要识别外观本身（如天气、材质、病变特征）的任务中会导致关键信息丢失，因此需要一种能将外观作为语义模态进行解耦的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 ST-STORM 的混合自监督学习框架，包含两个并行的潜在分支：内容分支（Content branch）利用 JEPA 方案和对比学习目标实现语义不变性；风格分支（Style branch）通过特征预测、重构及对抗约束来捕捉纹理、对比度等外观特征，并利用门控机制进行调节。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上保持了 80% 的语义分类性能，同时在 Multi-Weather 和 ISIC 2024 数据集上分别取得了 97% 和 94% 的 F1 分数，证明了该方法在提取复杂外观特征方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ST-STORM 成功实现了内容与风格的显式解耦，证明了将外观作为语义模态处理对于复杂视觉任务的必要性，并在多个基准测试中达到了优异性能。
AI.translation: 自监督学习 (SSL) 的主流范式（如 MoCo 或 DINO）旨在通过捕捉对照明或几何变化等图像变换不敏感的特征来生成鲁棒的表示。当目标是在不考虑外观的情况下识别物体时，这种策略是合适的。然而，一旦外观本身构成了判别信号，这种方法就适得其反。例如，在天气分析中，雨痕、雪颗粒、大气散射以及反射和光晕并非噪声，而是携带了重要信息。在自动驾驶等关键应用中，忽略这些线索是危险的，因为抓地力和能见度直接取决于地面和大气条件。我们引入了 ST-STORM，这是一种混合 SSL 框架，将外观（风格）视为一种需要与内容解耦的语义模态。我们的架构通过门控机制显式分离了两个潜在分支。内容分支旨在通过结合 JEPA 方案和对比目标来实现稳定的语义表示，从而促进对外观变化的不变性；并行地，风格分支受到约束，通过特征预测和重构以及对抗性约束来捕捉外观特征（纹理、对比度、散射）。我们在包括图像分类 (ImageNet-1K)、细粒度天气表征和黑色素瘤检测 (ISIC 2024 Challenge) 在内的多项任务上评估了 ST-STORM。结果表明，风格分支能够有效地分离复杂的外观现象（在 Multi-Weather 上 F1=97%，在 10% 标记数据的 ISIC 2024 上 F1=94%），且不会降低内容分支的语义性能（ImageNet-1K 上 F1=80%），并改善了对关键外观特征的保留。
AI.summary: 本文提出 ST-STORM 框架，旨在解决自监督学习中过度追求外观不变性导致的语义信息丢失问题。通过将内容与外观（风格）显式解耦为两个分支，模型既能保持稳定的语义识别能力，又能精确捕捉如天气现象或病理特征等关键的外观信息，在多个分类及细粒度识别任务中表现出色。
AI.keywords: 自监督学习, 风格解耦, 语义表示, 计算机视觉, 特征表示
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地解决了自监督学习中“不变性”倾向带来的局限性，通过显式解耦内容和风格，使得模型不仅能捕捉语义，还能提取关键的视觉表象特征。这种设计在自动驾驶和医学影像等对细微视觉特征敏感的领域具有重要的应用价值。

title: The Harder Path: Last Iterate Convergence for Uncoupled Learning in Zero-Sum Games with Bandit Feedback
comments: Accepted at the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2025)
summary: We study the problem of learning in zero-sum matrix games with repeated play and bandit feedback. Specifically, we focus on developing uncoupled algorithms that guarantee, without communication between players, the convergence of the last-iterate to a Nash equilibrium. Although the non-bandit case has been studied extensively, this setting has only been explored recently, with a bound of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/8})$ on the exploitability gap. We show that, for uncoupled algorithms, guaranteeing convergence of the policy profiles to a Nash equilibrium is detrimental to the performance, with the best attainable rate being $Ω(T^{-1/4})$ in contrast to the usual $Ω(T^{-1/2})$ rate for convergence of the average iterates. We then propose two algorithms that achieve this optimal rate up to constant and logarithmic factors. The first algorithm leverages a straightforward trade-off between exploration and exploitation, while the second employs a regularization technique based on a two-step mirror descent approach.
comment: Accepted at the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2025)

AI.title_translation: 更艰难的路径：零和博弈中具有Bandit反馈的非耦合学习的最后迭代收敛
AI.tldr: 本文证明了零和博弈中Bandit反馈下最后迭代收敛的最优速率为 Ω(T^-1/4)，并提出了两种达到该速率的非耦合学习算法。
AI.motivation: 研究在缺乏玩家间通信的非耦合设置下，零和矩阵博弈中利用Bandit反馈实现最后迭代收敛到纳什均衡的问题，并试图突破现有的收敛速度限制。
AI.method: 提出了两种算法：第一种通过平衡探索与利用来实现；第二种采用基于两步镜像下降法的正则化技术。
AI.result: 证明了非耦合算法实现最后迭代收敛的理论最优速率为 Ω(T^-1/4)，并设计了能够达到此速率的算法。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了在零和博弈中实现最后迭代收敛存在基础性能限制，并提出了能够达到该最优速率的两种新算法。
AI.translation: 我们研究了具有重复博弈和Bandit反馈的零和矩阵博弈中的学习问题。具体而言，我们专注于开发非耦合算法，在无需玩家间通信的情况下，保证最后迭代收敛到纳什均衡。尽管非Bandit情况已被广泛研究，但该设置近期才开始被探索，且目前仅有 O(T^-1/8) 的可利用性差距界限。我们证明了对于非耦合算法，保证策略配置收敛到纳什均衡会损害性能，其最佳可达速率为 Ω(T^-1/4)，这与平均迭代收敛通常的 Ω(T^-1/2) 速率形成对比。随后，我们提出了两种算法，它们在常数和对数因子范围内达到了这一最优速率。第一种算法利用了探索与利用之间的直接权衡，而第二种算法采用了基于两步镜像下降法的正则化技术。
AI.summary: 本文研究了零和博弈中基于Bandit反馈的非耦合学习问题。作者指出，追求最后迭代收敛会导致性能下降，其最优收敛速率为 Ω(T^-1/4)。为此，作者提出了两种算法，通过探索-利用权衡或两步镜像下降法，成功达到了这一理论最优速率。
AI.keywords: 零和博弈, Bandit反馈, 最后迭代收敛, 非耦合学习, 纳什均衡
AI.comments: 该论文在零和博弈中解决了具有挑战性的“最后迭代收敛”问题，特别是在仅有部分信息（Bandit反馈）的约束下。其核心贡献在于证明了在非耦合算法中，追求最后迭代收敛会牺牲收敛速度，并提出了达到该理论最优速率的算法，这对于博弈论和强化学习的实际应用具有重要意义。

title: Characterization of Real Communication Patterns and Congestion Dynamics in HPC Interconnection Networks
comments: Submitted to ACM TACO on Jan 4th 2026
summary: The interconnection network is a key component of Supercomputers and Data centers, and its design must cope with the increasing communication demands of current applications and services; otherwise, it may become a system bottleneck. The most challenging network design issues are the topology, routing algorithm, flow control, and power efficiency. However, even the most efficient interconnection networks may suffer severe performance degradation due to congestion, especially under specific network traffic patterns generated by communication operations in high-performance computing~(HPC), deep learning training, or online data-intensive services. In this context, characterizing and modeling these communication operations and the network traffic patterns they generate is a fundamental challenge for studying their impact on network performance. This paper presents a methodology, based primarily on the VEF Traces framework, to characterize, model, and simulate the communication patterns of representative computing- and data-intensive applications. More precisely, we have extended the VEF traces framework with tools that enable us to characterize network congestion, either directly from VEF traces or via simulations. We have analyzed a set of VEF traces obtained from runs of NEST, GROMACS, LAMMPS, and PATMOS on several Supercomputers. In these studies, we identify potential congestion scenarios that arise in realistic network configurations when certain collective operations are performed.
comment: Submitted to ACM TACO on Jan 4th 2026

AI.title_translation: 高性能计算互连网络中真实通信模式和拥塞动态的表征
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于VEF Traces框架的方法，用于表征、建模和模拟高性能计算应用中的通信模式和网络拥塞，并通过分析NEST、GROMACS、LAMMPS和PATMOS等应用的VEF traces，识别出在现实网络配置中可能出现的拥塞场景。
AI.motivation: 高性能计算（HPC）、深度学习训练或数据密集型在线服务等应用产生的通信操作，可能导致网络流量模式在互连网络中出现拥塞，从而严重影响网络性能。因此，表征和建模这些通信操作及其产生的网络流量模式，对于研究其对网络性能的影响至关重要。
AI.method: 该论文提出了一种基于VEF Traces框架的方法，并对其进行了扩展，增加了能够直接从VEF traces或通过模拟来表征网络拥塞的工具。研究人员分析了在多个超级计算机上运行NEST、GROMACS、LAMMPS和PATMOS等应用时获得的VEF traces。
AI.result: 通过对NEST、GROMACS、LAMMPS和PATMOS等应用的VEF traces进行分析，研究人员识别出了在现实网络配置中，当执行某些集体操作时可能出现的潜在拥塞场景。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种表征和模拟HPC通信模式和网络拥塞的方法，并初步识别了可能导致拥塞的场景，为优化网络设计和性能提供了依据。
AI.translation: 互连网络是超级计算机和数据中心的组成部分，其设计必须应对当前应用程序和服务的日益增长的通信需求；否则，它可能成为系统瓶颈。最具挑战性的网络设计问题是拓扑、路由算法、流量控制和功耗效率。然而，即使是最有效的互连网络，也可能因拥塞而遭受严重的性能下降，尤其是在高性能计算（HPC）、深度学习训练或数据密集型在线服务中的通信操作所产生的特定网络流量模式下。在此背景下，表征和建模这些通信操作及其产生的网络流量模式，是研究它们对网络性能影响的基本挑战。本文提出了一种主要基于VEF Traces框架的方法，用于表征、建模和模拟代表性计算密集型和数据密集型应用程序的通信模式。更具体地说，我们已经扩展了VEF traces框架，并增加了能够直接从VEF traces或通过模拟来表征网络拥塞的工具。我们分析了一组在多个超级计算机上运行NEST、GROMACS、LAMMPS和PATMOS时获得的VEF traces。在这些研究中，我们识别出了在现实网络配置中，当执行某些集体操作时可能出现的潜在拥塞场景。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用VEF Traces框架来表征、建模和模拟高性能计算（HPC）应用中通信模式和网络拥塞的方法。通过扩展VEF Traces框架，研究人员能够分析实际运行产生的网络流量，并识别出可能导致网络性能下降的拥塞场景。对NEST、GROMACS、LAMMPS和PATMOS等应用的分析表明，在特定的网络配置和通信操作下，拥塞是真实存在的。
AI.keywords: 网络拥塞,高性能计算,通信模式,VEF Traces,网络性能
AI.comments: 该研究解决了高性能计算网络中的一个关键问题——通信拥塞。所提出的基于VEF Traces框架的方法为理解和模拟复杂的网络流量模式提供了一个有价值的工具。然而，该研究的局限性在于其分析主要集中在特定的应用程序和硬件配置上，未来的工作可以扩展到更广泛的应用场景和网络拓扑，并进一步探索缓解拥塞的策略。

title: Robust Synchronisation for Federated Learning in The Face of Correlated Device Failure
summary: Probabilistic Synchronous Parallel (PSP) is a technique in distributed learning systems to reduce synchronization bottlenecks by sampling a subset of participating nodes per round. In Federated Learning (FL), where edge devices are often unreliable due to factors including mobility, power constraints, and user activity, PSP helps improve system throughput. However, PSP has a key limitation: it assumes device behavior is static and different devices are independent. This can lead to unfair distributed synchronization, due to highly available nodes dominating training while those that are often unavailable rarely participate and so their data may be missed. If both data distribution and node availability are simultaneously correlated with the device, then both PSP and standard FL algorithms will suffer from persistent under-representation of certain classes or groups resulting in inefficient or ineffective learning of certain features. We introduce Availability-Weighted PSP (AW-PSP), an extension to PSP that addresses the issue of co-correlation of unfair sampling and data availability by dynamically adjusting node sampling probabilities using real-time availability predictions, historical behavior, and failure correlation metrics. A Markov-based availability predictor distinguishes transient \emph{vs} chronic failures, while a Distributed Hash Table (DHT) layer decentralizes metadata, including latency, freshness, and utility scores. We implement AW-PSP and trace-driven evaluation shows that it improves robustness to both independent and correlated failures, increases label coverage, and reduces fairness variance compared to standard PSP. AW-PSP thus provides an availability-aware, and fairness-conscious node sampling protocol for FL deployments that will scale to large numbers of nodes even in heterogeneous and failure-prone environments.

AI.title_translation: 面向关联设备故障的联邦学习鲁棒同步机制
AI.tldr: AW-PSP 通过动态调整设备采样概率，解决了联邦学习中因设备可用性差异导致的数据偏见和训练不公平问题。
AI.motivation: 现有概率同步并行 (PSP) 方法假设节点行为独立且静态，在联邦学习中会导致高可用节点主导训练，进而引发数据分布偏差和特定特征学习不足的问题。
AI.method: 提出 Availability-Weighted PSP (AW-PSP) 算法，利用基于马尔可夫的可用性预测器区分瞬时与长期故障，并结合分布式哈希表 (DHT) 管理节点元数据，动态调整节点的采样概率。
AI.result: 实验表明，与标准 PSP 相比，AW-PSP 在应对独立及相关性故障时表现出更强的鲁棒性，显著提高了标签覆盖率并降低了公平性偏差。
AI.conclusion: AW-PSP 通过动态调整采样概率，成功解决了联邦学习中设备可用性与数据分布相关性导致的偏差问题，提升了模型训练的公平性与鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 概率同步并行 (PSP) 是一种分布式学习系统中通过在每轮采样部分参与节点来减少同步瓶颈的技术。在联邦学习 (FL) 中，由于移动性、功率限制和用户活动等因素，边缘设备往往不可靠，PSP 有助于提高系统吞吐量。然而，PSP 有一个关键限制：它假设设备行为是静态的且不同设备是独立的。这可能导致不公平的分布式同步，因为高可用节点主导训练，而那些经常不可用的节点很少参与，导致其数据可能被遗漏。如果数据分布和节点可用性同时与设备相关联，那么 PSP 和标准 FL 算法都会遭受某些类别或群体的持续代表性不足，导致某些特征的学习效率低下或无效。我们引入了可用性加权 PSP (AW-PSP)，这是 PSP 的一个扩展，通过使用实时可用性预测、历史行为和故障相关性指标动态调整节点采样概率，解决了不公平采样和数据可用性相互关联的问题。一个基于马尔可夫的可用性预测器区分了瞬时故障和长期故障，而分布式哈希表 (DHT) 层分散了元数据，包括延迟、新鲜度和效用分数。我们实现了 AW-PSP，基于轨迹的评估表明，与标准 PSP 相比，它提高了对独立和相关故障的鲁棒性，增加了标签覆盖率，并减少了公平性方差。因此，AW-PSP 为 FL 部署提供了一种可用性感知和公平性意识的节点采样协议，即使在异构和易发生故障的环境中也能扩展到大量节点。
AI.summary: 针对联邦学习中设备不稳定性引发的数据偏差问题，本文提出了一种可用性加权概率同步并行 (AW-PSP) 协议。该方法通过实时预测节点可用性并根据历史行为动态调整采样权重，有效缓解了因设备故障相关性导致的训练不公平，提升了学习效率与模型性能。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 概率同步并行, 设备故障, 可用性加权, 公平性
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的调度策略，通过引入可用性加权机制解决了联邦学习中设备故障相关性带来的偏差问题。其亮点在于结合了马尔可夫预测器和分布式哈希表（DHT），在保持去中心化的同时提升了系统的公平性和鲁棒性，对于大规模异构边缘计算环境具有重要的实际意义。

title: Toward EU Sovereignty in Space: A Comparative Simulation Study of IRIS 2 and Starlink
summary: The evolution of 6th generation (6G) networks increasingly relies on satellite-based Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTNs) to extend broadband connectivity to remote and unserved regions, and to support public safety. In this paper we compare two representative and conceptually different satellite constellation architectures, namely Starlink and IRIS 2. Starlink is a commercial private Internet constellation by SpaceX, based on dense Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites. It is primarily designed to deliver high-capacity broadband services for civil applications, with performance targets comparable to those of terrestrial networks. In contrast, IRIS 2 is a planned public initiative to be deployed by the European Union, based on a multi-layer combination of LEO, Medium Earth Orbit (MEO), and Geo-stationary Earth Orbit (GEO) satellites. It is primarily designed to provide a secure, resilient, and sovereign infrastructure for government and critical communications. After describing the main technical characteristics of Starlink and IRIS 2, we run a comprehensive simulation campaign to evaluate the design tradeoffs between the two. Specifically, we evaluate the per-cell and per-user achievable capacity, the impact of satellite mobility and handover, and identify the capability of each architecture to support global and reliable connectivity. We also provide design suggestions for possible future IRIS 2 deployment extensions.

AI.title_translation: 迈向欧盟空间主权：IRIS 2与Starlink的比较仿真研究
AI.tldr: 本文通过仿真对比了Starlink（民用宽带）与IRIS 2（欧盟政府级安全通信）两种卫星星座的架构差异，评估了其在性能、可靠性及空间主权方面的权衡。
AI.motivation: 随着6G对非地面网络（NTN）的依赖增强，欧盟旨在通过IRIS 2计划实现空间主权，迫切需要评估其与现有商业化星座（如Starlink）在技术架构和性能上的差异与权衡。
AI.method: 采用综合仿真实验方法，对比分析Starlink（密集LEO）与IRIS 2（LEO/MEO/GEO多层）两种架构，评估指标包括单小区/单用户容量、卫星移动性、切换性能以及全球连接的可靠性。
AI.result: 仿真结果明确了两种系统的设计权衡，揭示了Starlink在宽带性能方面的表现，以及IRIS 2在满足政府及关键通信需求方面的架构优势，并为IRIS 2的未来扩展提出了设计建议。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，Starlink在民用高容量宽带方面具有显著优势，而IRIS 2通过多层轨道架构在政府级通信的安全性与弹性上更具战略意义，两者的设计目标差异决定了其不同的技术选型。
AI.translation: 6G网络的发展日益依赖于基于卫星的非地面网络（NTN），以将宽带连接扩展到偏远和未覆盖地区，并支持公共安全。在本文中，我们比较了两种具有代表性且概念上不同的卫星星座架构，即Starlink和IRIS 2。Starlink是SpaceX旗下的商业私人互联网星座，基于密集的低地球轨道（LEO）卫星。它主要旨在为民用应用提供高容量宽带服务，其性能目标可与地面网络相媲美。相比之下，IRIS 2是欧盟计划部署的一项公共倡议，基于LEO、中地球轨道（MEO）和地球静止轨道（GEO）卫星的多层组合。它主要旨在为政府和关键通信提供安全、弹性和主权基础设施。在描述了Starlink和IRIS 2的主要技术特征后，我们开展了一场综合仿真运动，以评估两者之间的设计权衡。具体而言，我们评估了每小区和每用户的可实现容量、卫星移动性和切换的影响，并确定了每种架构支持全球和可靠连接的能力。我们还为可能的IRIS 2未来部署扩展提供了设计建议。
AI.summary: 本文对比分析了Starlink和IRIS 2两种卫星星座架构。Starlink专注于民用高容量宽带，采用密集LEO架构；IRIS 2则是欧盟的公共项目，采用多层轨道架构以保障政府安全通信。通过仿真对比，研究评估了两者在容量、移动性及可靠性方面的性能差异。
AI.keywords: 6G, 非地面网络(NTN), Starlink, IRIS 2, 卫星星座
AI.comments: 本文通过对比商业化成熟的Starlink与欧盟主导的IRIS 2，探讨了卫星通信网络在民用高带宽与政府级安全通信两种不同目标下的架构差异。其创新点在于通过仿真量化评估了不同轨道配置（LEO vs 多层轨道）的技术权衡，为欧洲实现空间主权提供了重要的科学依据。

title: GroupEnvoy: A Conversational Agent Speaking for the Outgroup to Foster Intergroup Relations
summary: Conversational agents have the potential to support intergroup relations when psychological or linguistic barriers prevent direct interaction. Based on intergroup contact theory, we propose GroupEnvoy, a conversational agent that represents outgroup perspectives during ingroup discussions, grounded in transcripts from outgroup-only sessions. To evaluate this approach and derive design principles, we conducted a mixed-methods, between-subjects study with university students, where host-country students formed the ingroup and international students formed the outgroup. Ingroup students performed a collaborative task, receiving outgroup perspectives via GroupEnvoy (experimental) or reading written transcripts (control). Compared to the control group, the experimental group showed greater reduction in intergroup anxiety and greater improvement in perspective-taking. Qualitatively, AI-mediated contact enhanced outcome expectancies, whereas passive exposure fostered future contact intentions. The two conditions also elicited empathy toward distinct targets: outgroup evaluations of the ingroup versus outgroup lived experiences. These findings validate AI-mediated contact as a promising paradigm for improving intergroup relations.

AI.title_translation: GroupEnvoy：一个为外群体发声以促进群体间关系的对话代理
AI.tldr: GroupEnvoy利用对话代理在内群体讨论中传达外群体观点，实验证明其能有效减轻群体焦虑并提升视角采择，是改善跨群体关系的一种有前景的AI方案。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决当心理或语言障碍阻止直接互动时，利用对话代理（Conversational Agents）来支持和改善跨群体关系。
AI.method: 采用混合方法、被试间实验设计。将大学生分为主机国学生（内群体）和留学生（外群体）。实验组通过GroupEnvoy获取外群体观点，对照组阅读书面记录，随后进行协作任务并测量心理指标。
AI.result: 与对照组相比，实验组在群体间焦虑的降低和视角采择的提升方面表现更好。定性分析显示，AI介导的接触增强了结果预期，而被动接触促进了未来互动的意愿。
AI.conclusion: GroupEnvoy证明了AI介导的接触是改善跨群体关系的有效范式，能够显著降低群体间焦虑并提升视角采择能力，为设计促进社会和谐的对话系统提供了新思路。
AI.translation: 对话代理有潜力在心理或语言障碍阻止直接互动时支持群体间关系。基于群体接触理论，我们提出了GroupEnvoy，这是一个在内群体讨论中代表外群体视角的对话代理，基于外群体专属会议的记录。为了评估这种方法并导出设计原则，我们对大学生进行了混合方法、被试间研究，其中主机国学生构成内群体，国际学生构成外群体。内群体学生执行协作任务，通过GroupEnvoy（实验组）接收外群体观点，或阅读书面记录（对照组）。与对照组相比，实验组在降低群体间焦虑和提高视角采择方面表现更好。定性地看，AI介导的接触增强了结果预期，而被动接触培养了未来接触的意愿。这两种条件还引发了对不同目标的同理心：对外群体评价内群体的看法，以及对外群体生活经历的同理心。这些发现验证了AI介导的接触是改善群体间关系的一种有前景的范式。
AI.summary: 本文提出了GroupEnvoy，一种旨在内群体讨论中代表外群体视角的对话代理。通过对比实验，验证了该系统能有效缓解群体间焦虑并增强视角采择，为利用AI技术改善跨群体关系提供了实证支持。
AI.keywords: GroupEnvoy, 群体接触理论, 对话代理, 跨群体关系, AI介导的接触
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入AI作为“群体特使”打破了跨群体沟通的壁垒，创新性地将人机交互技术应用于社会心理学中的群体接触理论。其局限性可能在于实验环境相对受控，且AI生成内容的准确性与偏见控制对实际应用效果有重大影响。

title: Compositional Design, Implementation, and Verification of Swarms (Technical Report)
comments: 43 pages, 15 figures, Related version accepted at ECOOP 2026 conference
summary: Swarm protocols are a recently introduced formalism for specifying, implementing, and verifying peer-to-peer systems called swarms. A swarm consists of distributed agents called machines that communicate by asynchronous event propagation. Following a local-first model, each machine can progress without requiring continuous connectivity to other machines. Existing models of swarms are not compositional, making the modular development of large and complex swarm applications as well as the reuse of code difficult. We address these issues by presenting novel theory and techniques for the compositional specification, verification, and implementation of swarms. These results enable the correct compositional reuse of pre-existing swarm protocols and machine implementations. We implement these contributions in a companion software artifact which enables the automatic integration of independently designed and verified swarm components.
comment: 43 pages, 15 figures, Related version accepted at ECOOP 2026 conference

AI.title_translation: 群组（Swarm）的组合式设计、实现与验证（技术报告）
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种组合式Swarm协议设计与验证框架，解决了分布式系统开发中组件难以重用和模块化的问题，并提供了自动化集成工具。
AI.motivation: 现有的Swarm模型缺乏组合性，导致大规模复杂Swarm应用的模块化开发困难，且难以重用已有的代码和协议。
AI.method: 提出了一套用于Swarm协议组合式规格说明、验证和实现的理论模型，并开发了相应的软件工具以实现独立设计组件的自动集成。
AI.result: 实现了支持Swarm组件组合式重用的理论框架，并开发了一个配套软件工具，能够自动集成独立设计和验证的Swarm组件。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过建立组合式Swarm协议理论与实现框架，成功解决了复杂分布式系统开发中的模块化和重用性问题，并提供了自动化工具支持。
AI.translation: Swarm协议是最近引入的一种用于指定、实现和验证称为Swarm的点对点系统的形式化方法。Swarm由通过异步事件传播进行通信的分布式代理（机器）组成。遵循“本地优先”模型，每台机器都可以在不需要与其他机器保持持续连接的情况下运行。现有的Swarm模型不具备组合性，使得大型复杂Swarm应用的模块化开发以及代码重用变得困难。我们通过提出用于Swarm组合式规格说明、验证和实现的新颖理论和技术来解决这些问题。这些结果实现了预先存在的Swarm协议和机器实现的正确组合式重用。我们在配套的软件工件中实现了这些贡献，该工件支持独立设计和验证的Swarm组件的自动集成。
AI.summary: 本文针对Swarm协议缺乏组合性的问题，提出了一套新的理论与技术框架，支持Swarm协议和机器实现的组合式规格说明、验证与实现，并提供了支持组件自动集成的软件工具，促进了复杂分布式系统的模块化开发。
AI.keywords: Swarm协议, 分布式系统, 组合性, 形式化验证, 模块化设计
AI.comments: 该论文解决了分布式系统开发中长期存在的组合性难题，通过引入组合式理论和技术，使得大规模点对点系统的模块化开发和协议重用成为可能，具有重要的工程实践价值。

title: DenTab: A Dataset for Table Recognition and Visual QA on Real-World Dental Estimates
summary:
Tables condense key transactional and administrative information into compact layouts, but practical extraction requires more than text recognition: systems must also recover structure (rows, columns, merged cells, headers) and interpret roles such as line items, subtotals, and totals under common capture artifacts. Many existing resources for table structure recognition and TableVQA are built from clean digital-born sources or rendered tables, and therefore only partially reflect noisy administrative conditions.
  We introduce DenTab, a dataset of 2{,}000 cropped table images from dental estimates with high-quality HTML annotations, enabling evaluation of table recognition (TR) and table visual question answering (TableVQA) on the same inputs. DenTab includes 2{,}208 questions across eleven categories spanning retrieval, aggregation, and logic/consistency checks. We benchmark 16 systems, including 14 vision--language models (VLMs) and two OCR baselines. Across models, strong structure recovery does not consistently translate into reliable performance on multi-step arithmetic and consistency questions, and these reasoning failures persist even when using ground-truth HTML table inputs.
  To improve arithmetic reliability without training, we propose the Table Router Pipeline, which routes arithmetic questions to deterministic execution. The pipeline combines (i) a VLM that produces a baseline answer, a structured table representation, and a constrained table program with (ii) a rule-based executor that performs exact computation over the parsed table. The source code and dataset will be made publicly available at https://github.com/hamdilaziz/DenTab.

AI.title_translation: 真实世界牙科估算中的表格识别和视觉问答数据集
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了DenTab数据集，用于评估真实世界牙科估算表格的识别和视觉问答能力。由于现有数据集多基于干净的数字源，无法反映实际情况，因此DenTab包含2000张带有HTML标注的牙科估算表格图像。研究发现，即使是先进的视觉语言模型，在处理多步算术和一致性问题时也存在困难。为解决此问题，研究提出了一种名为Table Router Pipeline的方法，该方法结合了视觉语言模型和基于规则的执行器，以提高算术问题的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有表格识别和表格视觉问答资源多基于干净的数字源或渲染表格，无法充分反映现实世界中表格因拍摄伪影等因素导致的嘈杂条件下的实际提取需求。
AI.method: 研究提出了DenTab数据集，包含2000张来自牙科估算的、带有高质量HTML标注的表格图像，用于表格识别（TR）和表格视觉问答（TableVQA）的评估。此外，研究还提出了一种名为Table Router Pipeline的方法，该方法结合了视觉语言模型（VLM）和一个基于规则的执行器，用于处理算术问题，其中VLM负责生成初步答案、结构化表格表示和约束表格程序，而执行器则负责进行精确计算。
AI.result: 在DenTab数据集上对16个系统（包括14个视觉语言模型和2个OCR基线）的基准测试表明，强大的结构恢复能力并不总能转化为多步算术和一致性问题的可靠性能，即使使用真实的HTML表格输入，这些推理上的失败仍然存在。Table Router Pipeline通过将算术问题路由到确定性执行器，提高了算术问题的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: DenTab数据集为评估真实世界嘈杂条件下的表格识别和TableVQA提供了宝贵的资源。研究发现，现有的视觉语言模型在处理需要多步算术和逻辑推理的问题时存在局限性，即使在有真实HTML表格输入的情况下也是如此。Table Router Pipeline作为一种无需额外训练的解决方案，能够显著提高算术问题的准确性。
AI.translation:
表格浓缩了关键的交易和管理信息，但实际提取不仅需要文本识别，还需要恢复结构（行、列、合并单元格、标题）并解释诸如项目、小计和总计等角色，尤其是在常见的拍摄伪影下。许多现有的表格结构识别和表格视觉问答资源都基于干净的数字源或渲染表格，因此只能部分反映嘈杂的实际条件。
我们引入了DenTab，一个包含2000张来自牙科估算的表格图像的数据集，并附有高质量的HTML标注，能够对同一输入进行表格识别（TR）和表格视觉问答（TableVQA）的评估。DenTab包含2208个问题，涵盖检索、聚合和逻辑/一致性检查共十一个类别。我们对16个系统进行了基准测试，包括14个视觉语言模型（VLMs）和2个OCR基线。在所有模型中，强大的结构恢复能力并不总能转化为多步算术和一致性问题的可靠性能，并且即使使用真实的HTML表格输入，这些推理失败仍然存在。
为了在不进行训练的情况下提高算术可靠性，我们提出了Table Router Pipeline，它将算术问题路由到确定性执行器。该管道结合了（i）一个生成基线答案、结构化表格表示和约束表格程序的VLM，以及（ii）一个对解析后的表格执行精确计算的基于规则的执行器。源代码和数据集将在https://github.com/hamdilaziz/DenTab公开发布。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了DenTab数据集，一个包含2000张真实世界牙科估算表格图像及其HTML标注的数据集，旨在解决现有表格识别和视觉问答数据集在处理嘈杂现实条件方面的不足。研究通过在DenTab上评估多种模型，发现即使是先进的视觉语言模型在处理多步算术和逻辑推理问题时也存在困难。为克服这一挑战，研究提出了一种结合视觉语言模型和基于规则的执行器的Table Router Pipeline，以提高算术问题的准确性，并将公开数据集和代码。
AI.keywords: 表格识别, 视觉问答, 牙科估算, 数据集, 表格路由器管道
AI.comments: 该研究在真实世界嘈杂表格数据方面填补了一个重要的空白，特别是在牙科估算领域。DenTab数据集的创建和评估非常有价值。然而，将视觉语言模型在多步推理任务上的局限性归因于“推理失败”可能过于宽泛，需要进一步探究模型在理解表格结构、识别单元格角色以及执行算术运算的具体环节上存在哪些挑战。Table Router Pipeline提供了一个有效的无需训练的解决方案，但其泛化能力和在更复杂表格结构上的表现有待进一步验证。

title: Decoding Algorithms for Tensor Codes
comments: 41 pages, 2 tables, 4 figures, long version of ISIT'2025 extended abstract with same title, IEEE preprint
summary: Tensor codes are a generalisation of matrix codes. Such codes are defined as subspaces of order-r tensors for which the ambient space is endowed with the tensor-rank as a metric. A class of these codes was introduced by Roth, who also outlined a decoding algorithm for low tensor-rank errors that can be generalised to an algorithm with exponential complexity in the decoding radius. They may be viewed as a generalisation of the well-known Delsarte-Gabidulin-Roth maximum rank distance codes. We study a generalised class of these codes. We investigate their properties and outline decoding techniques for different metrics that leverage their tensor structure. We first consider a fibre-wise decoding approach, as each fibre of a codeword corresponds to a Gabidulin codeword. We then give a generalisation of Loidreau-Overbeck's decoding method that corrects errors with properties constrained by the dimensions of the slice spaces and fibre spaces. The metrics we consider are bounded from above by the tensor-rank metric, and therefore these algorithms also decode tensor-rank weight errors.

title: Reckoning with the Political Economy of AI: Avoiding Decoys in Pursuit of Accountability
comments: To be presented at ACM FAccT, Montréal, Canada, June 25 to June 28, 2026
summary: The Project of AI is a world-building endeavor, wherein those who fund and develop AI systems both operate through and seek to sustain networks of power and wealth. As they expand their access to resources and configure our sociotechnical conditions, they benefit from the ways in which a suite of decoys animate scholars, critics, policymakers, journalists, and the public into co-constructing industry-empowering AI futures. Regardless of who constructs or nurtures them, these decoys often create the illusion of accountability while both masking the emerging political economies that the Project of AI has set into motion, and also contributing to the network-making power that is at the heart of the Project's extraction and exploitation. Drawing on literature at the intersection of communication, science and technology studies, and economic sociology, we examine how the Project of AI is constructed. We then explore five decoys that seemingly critique - but in actuality co-constitute - AI's emergent power relations and material political economy. We argue that advancing meaningful fairness or accountability in AI requires: 1) recognizing when and how decoys serve as a distraction, and 2) grappling directly with the material political economy of the Project of AI. Doing so will enable us to attend to the networks of power that make 'AI' possible, spurring new visions for how to realize a more just technologically entangled world.

title: Polyglot: Multilingual Style Preserving Speech-Driven Facial Animation
comments: The project website is available at https://fedenoce.github.io/polyglot/
summary: Speech-Driven Facial Animation (SDFA) has gained significant attention due to its applications in movies, video games, and virtual reality. However, most existing models are trained on single-language data, limiting their effectiveness in real-world multilingual scenarios. In this work, we address multilingual SDFA, which is essential for realistic generation since language influences phonetics, rhythm, intonation, and facial expressions. Speaking style is also shaped by individual differences, not only by language. Existing methods typically rely on either language-specific or speaker-specific conditioning, but not both, limiting their ability to model their interaction. We introduce Polyglot, a unified diffusion-based architecture for personalized multilingual SDFA. Our method uses transcript embeddings to encode language information and style embeddings extracted from reference facial sequences to capture individual speaking characteristics. Polyglot does not require predefined language or speaker labels, enabling generalization across languages and speakers through self-supervised learning. By jointly conditioning on language and style, it captures expressive traits such as rhythm, articulation, and habitual facial movements, producing temporally coherent and realistic animations. Experiments show improved performance in both monolingual and multilingual settings, providing a unified framework for modeling language and personal style in SDFA.

title: Convergence of a Finite Volume Scheme for the Navier-Stokes-Korteweg Model via Dissipative Solutions
summary: We propose a concept of dissipative weak (DW) solutions for the Navier-Stokes-Korteweg (NSK) system and prove conditional convergence of a structure-preserving finite volume scheme towards such a solution. DW solutions provide a generalized solution concept in computational fluid dynamics and have recently attracted significant attention. They provide an extension of the famous Lax Equivalence Theorem to nonlinear problems, i.e. consistency and stability of a numerical scheme imply convergence. Our work builds on recent advances where convergence towards DW solutions of structure-preserving schemes has been established for the Euler and Navier-Stokes equations. Indeed, we prove convergence of a recently proposed FV scheme by leveraging its conservation and dissipation properties as well as its consistency.

title: Sample Complexity Bounds for Stochastic Shortest Path with a Generative Model
comments: Accepted at the 32nd International Conference on Algorithmic Learning Theory (ALT 2021)
summary: We study the sample complexity of learning an $ε$-optimal policy in the Stochastic Shortest Path (SSP) problem. We first derive sample complexity bounds when the learner has access to a generative model. We show that there exists a worst-case SSP instance with $S$ states, $A$ actions, minimum cost $c_{\min}$, and maximum expected cost of the optimal policy over all states $B_{\star}$, where any algorithm requires at least $Ω(SAB_{\star}^3/(c_{\min}ε^2))$ samples to return an $ε$-optimal policy with high probability. Surprisingly, this implies that whenever $c_{\min} = 0$ an SSP problem may not be learnable, thus revealing that learning in SSPs is strictly harder than in the finite-horizon and discounted settings. We complement this lower bound with an algorithm that matches it, up to logarithmic factors, in the general case, and an algorithm that matches it up to logarithmic factors even when $c_{\min} = 0$, but only under the condition that the optimal policy has a bounded hitting time to the goal state.
comment: Accepted at the 32nd International Conference on Algorithmic Learning Theory (ALT 2021)

title: Logarithmic-Time Geodesically Convex Decomposition in Programmable Matter
summary: The decomposition of complex structures into simpler substructures is a powerful technique with a wide range of applications. We study the computation of decompositions in the context of programmable matter. The amoebot model is a well-established model for programmable matter, which places $n$ tiny robots called amoebots on the triangular grid. We consider the reconfigurable circuit extension of the geometric amoebot model, which allows amoebots to interconnect via so-called circuits. Amoebots can then instantaneously transmit simple beeps to all amoebots connected by the same circuit. Using reconfigurable circuits, previous papers have described a linear-time triangulation algorithm, and a logarithmic-time decomposition algorithm into so-called tunnel regions. Both algorithms only work on a restricted class of amoebot structures. In this paper, we define a decomposition into $O(|\mathcal H|)$ simple, geodesically convex regions for arbitrary amoebot structures, and show how it can compute such a decomposition in $O(\log n)$ rounds, where $|\mathcal H|$ denotes the number of holes in the amoebot structure. As a byproduct, we also improve the global maxima algorithm of Padalkin et al. (Nat. Comput., 2024) for special cases and with that also their spanning tree algorithm to $O(\log n)$ rounds w.h.p.

title: Co-Design of CNN Accelerators for TinyML using Approximate Matrix Decomposition
summary:
The paradigm shift towards local and on-device inference under stringent resource constraints is represented by the tiny machine learning (TinyML) domain. The primary goal of \gls{tml} is to integrate intelligence into tiny, low-cost devices under strict resource, energy, and latency constraints. However, the ultra-resource-constrained nature of these devices can lead to increased inference execution time, which can be detrimental in latency critical applications. At the same time, TinyML applications are often associated with sensitive data. As such, latency optimization approaches that rely on training samples are infeasible when such data is unavailable, proprietary, or sensitive, highlighting a pressing need for optimization approaches that do not require access to the training dataset and can be applied directly to pre-trained models. Replacing costly multiplications with more hardware-efficient operations, such as shifts and additions, has been proposed as an effective method for reducing inference latency. However, post-training power-of-two (Po2) approaches are scarce and, in many cases, lead to unacceptable accuracy loss.
  In this work, we propose a framework that applies approximate matrix decomposition to a given CNN in order to optimize hardware implementations subject to strict constraints and without any need of re-training or fine-tuning steps. The genetic algorithm-driven framework explores different matrix decompositions and resulting multiplier-less CNN accelerator designs for FPGA targets. A comprehensive evaluation of different TinyML benchmarks demonstrates our framework's efficacy in generating latency-optimized implementations that satisfy strict accuracy and resource constraints, achieving an average 33% latency improvement with an average accuracy loss of 1.3% compared to typical systolic array-based FPGA accelerators.

title: Towards In-Context Tone Style Transfer with A Large-Scale Triplet Dataset
summary: Tone style transfer for photo retouching aims to adapt the stylistic tone of the reference image to a given content image. However, the lack of high-quality large-scale triplet datasets with stylized ground truth forces existing methods to rely on self-supervised or proxy objectives, which limits model capability. To mitigate this gap, we design a data construction pipeline to build TST100K, a large-scale dataset of 100,000 content-reference-stylized triplets. At the core of this pipeline, we train a tone style scorer to ensure strict stylistic consistency for each triplet. In addition, existing methods typically extract content and reference features independently and then fuse them in a decoder, which may cause semantic loss and lead to inappropriate color transfer and degraded visual aesthetics. Instead, we propose ICTone, a diffusion-based framework that performs tone transfer in an in-context manner by jointly conditioning on both images, leveraging the semantic priors of generative models for semantic-aware transfer. Reward feedback learning using the tone style scorer is further incorporated to improve stylistic fidelity and visual quality. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of TST100K, and ICTone achieves state-of-the-art performance on both quantitative metrics and human evaluations.

title: From Articles to Canopies: Knowledge-Driven Pseudo-Labelling for Tree Species Classification using LLM Experts
summary: Hyperspectral tree species classification is challenging due to limited and imbalanced class labels, spectral mixing (overlapping light signatures from multiple species), and ecological heterogeneity (variability among ecological systems). Addressing these challenges requires methods that integrate biological and structural characteristics of vegetation, such as canopy architecture and interspecific interactions, rather than relying solely on spectral signatures. This paper presents a biologically informed, semi-supervised deep learning method that integrates multi-sensor Earth observation data, specifically hyperspectral imaging (HSI) and airborne laser scanning (ALS), with expert, ecological knowledge. The approach relies on biologically inspired pseudo-labelling over a precomputed canopy graph, yielding accurate classification at low training cost. In addition, ecological priors on species cohabitation are automatically derived from reliable sources using large language models (LLMs) and encoded as a cohabitation matrix with likelihoods of species occurring together. These priors are incorporated into the pseudo-labelling strategy, effectively introducing expert knowledge into the model. Experiments on a real-world forest dataset demonstrate 5.6% improvement over the best reference method. Expert evaluation of cohabitation priors reveals high accuracy with differences no larger than 15%.

title: The Relic Condition: When Published Scholarship Becomes Material for Its Own Replacement
summary: We extracted the scholarly reasoning systems of two internationally prominent humanities and social science scholars from their published corpora alone, converted those systems into structured inference-time constraints for a large language model, and tested whether the resulting scholar-bots could perform core academic functions at expert-assessed quality. The distillation pipeline used an eight-layer extraction method and a nine-module skill architecture grounded in local, closed-corpus analysis. The scholar-bots were then deployed across doctoral supervision, peer review, lecturing and panel-style academic exchange. Expert assessment involved three senior academics producing reports and appointment-level syntheses. Across the preserved expert record, all review and supervision reports judged the outputs benchmark-attaining, appointment-level recommendations placed both bots at or above Senior Lecturer level in the Australian university system, and recovered panel scores placed Scholar A between 7.9 and 8.9/10 and Scholar B between 8.5 and 8.9/10 under multi-turn debate conditions. A research-degree-student survey showed high performance ratings across information reliability, theoretical depth and logical rigor, with pronounced ceiling effects on a 7-point scale, despite all participants already being frontier-model users. We term this the Relic condition: when publication systems make stable reasoning architectures legible, extractable and cheaply deployable, the public record of intellectual labor becomes raw material for its own functional replacement. Because the technical threshold for this transition is already crossed at modest engineering effort, we argue that the window for protective frameworks covering disclosure, consent, compensation and deployment restriction is the present, while deployment remains optional rather than infrastructural.

title: SCRIPT: Implementing an Intelligent Tutoring System for Programming in a German University Context
comments: In: Cristea, A.I., Walker, E., Lu, Y., Santos, O.C., Isotani, S. (eds) Artificial Intelligence in Education. Posters and Late Breaking Results, Workshops and Tutorials, Industry and Innovation Tracks, Practitioners, Doctoral Consortium, Blue Sky, and WideAIED. AIED 2025. Communications in Computer and Information Science, vol 2590 . Springer, Cham
summary: Practice and extensive exercises are essential in programming education. Intelligent tutoring systems (ITSs) are a viable option to provide individualized hints and advice to programming students even when human tutors are not available. However, prior ITS for programming rarely support the Python programming language, mostly focus on introductory programming, and rarely take recent developments in generative models into account. We aim to establish a novel ITS for Python programming that is highly adaptable, serves both as a teaching and research platform, provides interfaces to plug in hint mechanisms (e.g.\ via large language models), and works inside the particularly challenging regulatory environment of Germany, that is, conforming to the European data protection regulation, the European AI act, and ethical framework of the German Research Foundation. In this paper, we present the description of the current state of the ITS along with future development directions, as well as discuss the challenges and opportunities for improving the system.
